coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston. The only exempt residences are those in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, and in non-profit facilities whose primary purpose is short-term substance-abuse treatment.
